item.title: Multi-use games court starts to take shape
item.description: Work has begun to bring a new public multi-use hardcourt games area to Grantham’s Dysart Park. The new facility is being installed at the South Kesteven District Council-owned park to replace a previous hard court at Wyndham Park, which is now home to new skate ramps. item.description: A notice for neighbours and the nearby communities of RAF Conningsby Exercise Agile Warrior 26, the RAF’s long-planned major homeland defence training activity, launches this week.
